topic: 限时听力：地图、设施与说明
grammarFocus: 位置介词、顺序表达、比较与变化描述。
title: Timed Listening and Public Information Design
prompt: In many public buildings, recorded announcements and audio guides are used to help visitors find their way and understand the facilities available. Some people argue that these spoken instructions are more effective than printed maps and signs, while others believe visual information remains essential. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明两种观点（语音说明的优势与视觉地图/标识的必要性），再明确给出你自己的立场，并用具体公共场所的例子支撑论证。注意任务要求为议论文，不需要描述图表数据；请确保全文不少于250词，并合理分配两个观点的篇幅。
